ops.title: Long-session deadline stalls are prepare_graph using the 0.75 s budget, not oversized events
ops.body:
Question (meta-desk-3, 1:40 PM Nov 6, from spawn-slice-cost's ccn b1e2080): meta-desk-3's own session logged "snapshot transport deadline elapsed" and "foreground transcript deadline exhausted" at 12:35:11 and 12:55:12 PT, each eating a spawn hook's budget. Does clipping explain them?

Answer: no. Read of ~/.cache/captain-hook/logs/72c2336c-375c-42d0-af9f-356b617fc964.log (965,991 lines, Nov 3 to Nov 6; its transcript is 399,994,839 bytes):

- Zero "record bound" lines in the whole log. No event in this session was ever over the record bound, so the bisection that the clipping fix removes never ran here.
- 22 transport-deadline stalls. The ones that use up the whole 0.75 s foreground budget (GRAPH_WORK_SECONDS) are single requests: prepare_graph at 725.6 ms (Nov 4 02:19:54), 697.3 ms (Nov 5 09:46:03), 739.8 ms (Nov 5 17:23:00), 731.8 ms (Nov 6 12:35:11), 740.6 ms (Nov 6 14:04:04), and an acquire plus tail pair at 749.3 and 751.6 ms (Nov 3 13:31:53). The others (query, resume, retain at 3 to 305 ms) start after the budget is already mostly spent.
- 345 "foreground transcript deadline exhausted" lines (255 retain, 68 query, 15 acquire, 6 resume, 1 tail). They are refused before sending, with elapsed_ms 0.0. They are the requests after the budget ran out in the same dispatch. At 12:55:12 the deadline was 12:55:11.959 and the first refused query came at 12:55:12.285. Nothing in the log names what spent that budget, because only failed requests are logged.

Cause: on this 400 MB transcript, one prepare_graph request (prepared graph evidence, captain_hook/snapshots/client.py graph_deadline, GRAPH_WORK_SECONDS = 0.75) takes about 700 to 740 ms. That is the whole PostToolUse foreground budget, so every later hook in the dispatch fails open on deadline. The cc-transcript 14.46.19 / captain-hook #681 clipping changes nothing on this path. Untested next step: log successful request timings (or prepare_graph's per-phase time) for one dispatch on this session to split the 0.75 s between acquire, prepare_graph and queries.
